CALLBACK.SUBTITLE: Paste this URL into the 微信客服 console (开发配置 → 企业内部接入) to verify the callback. Verification needs only the Token and EncodingAESKey you entered.

GUIDANCE.TITLE: Finish setup in the 微信客服 console
GUIDANCE.BODY: 1. Verify the callback URL above using your Token and EncodingAESKey. 2. After verification, WeCom reveals the Secret — save it below. 3. The Open KF ID is discovered automatically once the Secret is saved; set it manually only if you manage multiple KF accounts.
